cards.ex: I was tempted to lie about my qualifications, but honesty is the best policy.
cards.exUz: Men malakam haqida yolg'on gapirishga vasvasaga tushdim, lekin rostgo'ylik eng yaxshi siyosatdir.
cards.uzDef: Rost gapirish har doim eng to'g'ri yo'l, yolg'on gapirishdan ko'ra yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: The politician was criticized for lacking integrity and breaking his promises.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi halollik yetishmasligi va va'dalarini buzgani uchun tanqid qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy tamoyillarga ega bo'lmaslik, vijdonli bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: The country struggled to overcome a culture of corruption that permeated every level of government.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat hukumatning har bir darajasiga singib ketgan korrupsiya madaniyatini yengish uchun kurashdi.
cards.uzDef: Korrupsiya keng tarqalgan, odatiy hol bo'lib qolgan muhit.

cards.ex: We believe the company acted in good faith, even though the project failed.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniya loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lgan taqdirda ham halol niyatda harakat qilganiga ishonamiz.
cards.uzDef: Rostgo'ylik va halollik bilan, yashirin niyatlarsiz harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The senator had to resign due to a serious conflict of interest.
cards.exUz: Senator manfaatlar to'qnashuvi tufayli iste'foga chiqishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy manfaatlar kasbiy yoki rasmiy vazifalarga xalaqit beradigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: A judge should be above reproach in their personal and professional life.
cards.exUz: Sudya shaxsiy va kasbiy hayotida aybsiz bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday tanqid yoki ayblovga sabab bo'lmaslik, mutlaqo begunoh bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He lost his job after being caught taking a bribe from a developer.
cards.exUz: U quruvchidan pora olayotganda qo'lga tushganidan keyin ishidan ayrildi.
cards.uzDef: Noqonuniy xizmat ko'rsatish uchun pul yoki boshqa qimmatbaho narsalar qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The politician skirted the issue of tax increases during the interview.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi intervyu davomida soliqni oshirish masalasini chetlab o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy masalaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob bermaslik, undan qochish.

cards.ex: The whistleblower's evidence led to a major investigation.
cards.exUz: Xabar beruvchining dalillari katta tergovga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Tashkilot ichidagi noqonuniy yoki axloqsiz faoliyatni oshkor qiluvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: The scandal was finally brought out in the open.
cards.exUz: Janjal nihoyat ochiqchasiga oshkor etildi.
cards.uzDef: Yashirilmasdan, hammaga ko'rsatilib, oshkora qilinib.

cards.ex: One rotten apple can spoil the whole bunch.
cards.exUz: Bitta chirigan olma butun olmani buzishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Butun guruhga yomon ta'sir qiladigan biror yomon odam.

cards.ex: The CEO admitted it was a lapse in judgment to approve the deal.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor bu bitimni ma'qullash xato qaror bo'lganini tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik aqlsizlik yoki noto'g'ri qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: He spent years trying to clear his name after being wrongly accused.
cards.exUz: U noto'g'ri ayblangandan keyin nomini oqlash uchun yillar sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ayblovdan qutulish, aybsizligini isbotlash.

cards.ex: The accountant was arrested for allegedly falsifying financial records.
cards.exUz: Buxgalter moliyaviy hisobotlarni soxtalashtirganlikda gumonlanib hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Hujjatlardagi ma'lumotlarni o'zgartirish yoki yolg'on ma'lumot kiritish.

cards.ex: His unusual behavior raised suspicions among his colleagues.
cards.exUz: Uning g'ayrioddiy xulq-atvori hamkasblari orasida gumon uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Shubhali yoki noqonuniy narsalar haqida gumon paydo qilish.

cards.ex: The company fired the employee for unethical behavior.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xodimni axloqsiz xatti-harakatlari uchun ishdan bo'shatdi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy me'yorlarga zid bo'lgan harakatlar, noto'g'ri xatti-harakat.

cards.ex: The lack of transparency in the government's dealings is concerning.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ishlarida shaffoflikning yo'qligi tashvishlantirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ishlar va qarorlar qanday qabul qilinishi haqida ochiqlik va ma'lumotning yo'qligi.

cards.ex: They tried to whitewash the truth about the accident to protect their reputation.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z obro'sini himoya qilish uchun baxtsiz hodisa haqidagi haqiqatni yashirishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon yoki noqulay haqiqatni yashirish yoki kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The campaign turned nasty as both sides started playing dirty.
cards.exUz: Ikkala tomon ham noxolis o'ynay boshlagach, kampaniya yomonlashdi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun adolatsiz, axloqsiz usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: There's a lack of accountability among the senior management.
cards.exUz: Yuqori rahbariyat orasida javobgarlik yetishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z harakatlari va qarorlari uchun javobgar bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was willing to get his hands dirty to achieve his goals.
cards.exUz: U o'z maqsadlariga erishish uchun qo'lini bulg'ashga tayyor edi.
cards.uzDef: Nopok yoki noqonuniy ishlarda ishtirok etmoq.

cards.ex: She refused to make a moral compromise, even if it meant losing her job.
cards.exUz: U ishidan ayrilishiga to'g'ri kelgan taqdirda ham, axloqiy murosaga kelishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri deb bilgan narsangizdan voz kechish, axloqiy tamoyillarga zid harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's known for bending the rules to get what he wants.
cards.exUz: U xohlagan narsasiga erishish uchun qoidalarni buzishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni qat'iy rioya qilmaslik, ularni o'z manfaatlariga moslashtirish.

cards.ex: The scandal involved a massive cover-up to protect the company's reputation.
cards.exUz: Janjal kompaniya obro'sini himoya qilish uchun katta yashirishni o'z ichiga olgan.
cards.uzDef: Noqonuniy yoki noqulay ishni yashirishga qaratilgan harakatlar.

cards.ex: The company was accused of fleecing the public with its misleading advertising.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya noto'g'ri reklama bilan xalqni aldashda ayblandi.
cards.uzDef: Firibgarlik yoki aldash orqali xalqdan pul undirish.

cards.ex: He was accused of being complicit in the fraud.
cards.exUz: U firibgarlikda ishtirok etganlikda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir yomon yoki noqonuniy ishda sherik bo'lmoq, qatnashmoq.

cards.ex: The investigation uncovered a complex kickback scheme involving several politicians.
cards.exUz: Tergov bir nechta siyosatchilar ishtirokidagi murakkab qaytarma sxemasini aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: Korruptsiya sxemasi, bunda xizmat uchun yashirincha pul to'lanadi.

cards.ex: In public service, integrity is paramount.
cards.exUz: Davlat xizmatida halollik ustuvor ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Halollik eng muhim va birinchi o'rinda turadigan sifatdir.

cards.ex: The company's unusual financial transactions raised red flags with the auditors.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning g'ayrioddiy moliyaviy operatsiyalari auditorlar orasida xavotir uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Shubhali yoki noto'g'ri narsa ekanligini ko'rsatuvchi belgilar paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The company used a tax haven to avoid paying millions in taxes.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya millionlab soliq to'lashdan qochish uchun soliq jannatidan foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Soliqlar past yoki yo'q bo'lgan davlat yoki hudud.
